crossRefs.note: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in…
One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains…
that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because…
Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of…

translations.web: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.
translations.bsb: So we see that it was because of their unbelief that they were unable to enter.
translations.kjv: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
translations.asv: And we see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.
